item.title: A Deep Dive into rasa
item.description: With the rise of personal assistants like Siri, Google Assistant, Cortana, Alexa and how they're all called, there seems to be a great interest in chat bots, which are basically small text-based Alexas! So - exactly like 20 years ago - many companies want cool chat-bot interfaces for Facebook, WhatsApp or simply their website. That's where rasa comes into play. rasa is a startup that provides a framework for building bots utilizing the hottest and newest approaches, including Machine Learning™.

item.title: U.N. Interstellar was her?
item.description: So I've seen the new Christopher Nolan movie Interstellar yesterday! I had very mixed feelings about it and I will definitely see it again soon. The movie turned out pretty different that I had imagined and that threw me a bit off. This blog post however is not about the movie directly but about the music in it. So don't worry: no spoilers :)

item.title: Compression Distance
item.description: So I've recently looked into compression based distances as part of research for a masters course at the TU Berlin. What I found was a really interesting way of measuring distances between two textures (i.e. images).

item.title: My Octopress Blog
item.description: UPDATE: My blog now runs on pelican. Ignore this post. Really. So I have a new website/blog. It is made with the octopress blogging framework. Octopress is rather different from all the content management systems and blogs I've seen before. Since version 2.0 it is based on jekyll and thus has a completetly different approach on content management and creation. It uses rake tasks to accomplish most of the work. Because octopress is a framework, the comfort for creating and managing content are rather sparse, but then again it is really powerfull if you know what you're doing.
